run_oracle_selection: run OracleSelectionMethod to pick the last checkpoint's test accuracy across all hyperparameters
run_iid_accuracy_selection: run IIDAccuracySelectionMethod to select the model with highest mean training-domain validation accuracy
run_leave_one_out_selection: run LeaveOneOutSelectionMethod to pick the best model using leave-one-domain-out cross-validation
run_iid_auto_lr_selection: run IIDAutoLRAccuracySelectionMethod to select models using auto learning rate training-domain validation
summarize_selection_method_base: summarize the SelectionMethod abstract class and its hparams_accs and sweep_acc class methods
